entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: your code, $35 off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. What brings you to Replogle Globes today?
I'm looking for a globe for my husband.
That's a lovely idea. Is it for a special occasion, or just because?
It'll be a Christmas gift.
Christmas, nice. Does he travel a lot, or is he more of a history and maps person?
He's more of a history person.
A history lover, that suits an antique-style globe well. What would you say matters most when you pick a gift like this?
I'm just listening to what he would like. Also, I know he's interested in the the blue globe probably a larger one. I see you have a sixteen inch
blue globe with raised relief. I think he would like that one.
A sixteen-inch blue one with raised relief, great. I'll put the Trafalgar on your screen.
That's the Trafalgar, sixteen inches with raised relief, in stock at six hundred fifty dollars. It has a gunmetal look, so it's more modern than antique. Does that style feel like him?
Yes. However, he was looking for a tabletop model, not a floor model. We lived in a very small house.
That makes sense for a small house. A twelve-inch blue desktop globe with raised relief is the closest fit, so I'll put the Lincoln Blue on your screen. It's smaller than sixteen inches, though.

This is the Lincoln Blue, a twelve-inch globe with a walnut-colored hardwood base, in stock at one hundred seventy dollars. It stands twenty-one inches tall. Would that size work on his desk or table?
I think he would like something bigger. I do believe you have a sixteen inches desktop model with blue
and raised relief.
I think you may mean the Eureka, a sixteen-inch blue ocean globe with raised relief. I'll put it on your screen so we can check its size.

This is the Eureka, sixteen inches, blue ocean, raised relief, in stock at two hundred thirty-four seventy-five. I can't see its height here, so the page's dimensions will tell you if it fits a tabletop. Does a sixteen-inch globe feel right for his space?
I think it would work best. Yes.
Wonderful,
How long does it take
to get the globe delivered?

Orders are usually processed the same business day. After that, big cities take one to two business days, regional areas two to four, and rural areas five or more. Shipping is a flat ten dollars. Roughly when do you need it by?
I need it before Christmas. So I guess that shipping is not an issue.
Good, with Christmas still weeks away, there's plenty of room. Now, where else are you looking for a globe for him, or is this the main place?
Well, I have been searching online, and I found this site to be most helpful. I did find another site, but their globes are quite expensive. Do you sell these globes in any stores in Edmonton?
I'm not sure about physical stores, as I only know our online shop. The owner can tell you at (email hidden) Did you find us through a search, or something else?
I found you through a search.
Good to know, thank you. When you searched, what made you click on our site rather than the others?
It appeared that it was perhaps the first one that came up. And it appears to be a Canadian site.
Being Canadian clearly mattered to you, and that's good to hear. Is that mostly about shipping, or something else?
It's about shipping. It's about several things.
Fair
